title: Tennessee Small Claims Court (2026): Limit, Fees & How to File
rank_math_description: Tennessee small claims in 2026: $25,000 General Sessions limit, civil warrant costs ($145.75 in Nashville), trial on the warrant date and 10-day appeals.
pdf_outline: Checklist: demand letter -> county -> civil warrant -> fees (Davidson $145.75 + $52/extra defendant) -> sheriff service -> trial on warrant date (no written answer needed) -> 10-day de novo appeal -> garnishment / execution / lien
